profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Research at Carnegie Learning
profile.summary:
Zack Lee is dedicated to revolutionizing learning, creation, and technology interaction through innovative, user-friendly applications. With over 10 years of experience in open-source tools and full-stack web development, Zack focuses on making learning and creative expression more accessible and engaging.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Carnegie Learning, Zack's recent projects include UpGrade, an open-source A/B testing platform for education software, and LiveHint AI, the first Generative AI math tutor trained to think like a student.

Previously, Zack co-founded Iceblink Digital, a mobile music creation application startup which won numerous prizes and awards including the 3rd Prize in Creative Business Cup 2015. Zack also built Ofelia, an open-source creative coding tool for multimedia development, and participated in Google Summer of Code, where he worked on bringing the open-source software program Purr Data to the web browser.

Zack continues to explore new ways to support and inspire creative minds through technology, bridging the gap between technological complexity and user convenience.

positions.description:
• A program to develop open-source software which is sponsored and administered by Google
• Worked on making the graphical programming environment Purr Data run in a web browser by adding a WebAssembly target and HTML5 GUI framework
• Covered in the online magazine Create Digital Music
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C (Programming Language) · JavaScript · WebAssembly · Web Audio API

positions.description:
• Designed and built Ofelia, a real-time cross-platform creative coding tool for multimedia development
• Consulted on several projects that use Ofelia including World of Piano, an AR/VR application for music learning
• Won support for funding of approx. $10,000 from Gyeonggido Business & Science Accelerator
• Showcased at the NYC Media Lab Annual Summit 2019
• Presented at the Piksel Festival 2019
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C (Programming Language) · OpenFrameworks · Lua · Pure Data (Pd)

positions.title: Co-Founder & CEO
positions.locationName: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
positions.description:
• Established Iceblink Digital, Inc., a software development company
• Developed and launched Gemma, a peer-to-peer in-app marketplace for mobile music creation apps, and an easy-to-use app-builder GemmaLib
• Participated in a global accelerator program Startupbootcamp Mobile 2014
• Won a startup award at Danish Sound Day 2015
• Won the third prize in a global startup competition Creative Business Cup 2015
• Received seed funding of $25,000 from Flashstarts
• Exhibited at the Mobile World Congress 2016 in Barcelona, Spain
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · iOS development · OpenFrameworks · Pure Data (Pd) · Startup Development

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed KraftPad, a virtual analog drum synth iOS app
• Designed and developed PolyBeats, a polyrhythmic drum sequencer iOS app
• Won support for funding of approx. $8,000 from Gyeonggido Business & Science Accelerator Youth Frontier Startup Project
• Won support for office space and mentoring worth approx. $2,000 from Anyang Creative Industry Promotion Agency

positions.insights: Skills: Objective-C · iOS development · Pure Data (Pd) · Mobile Applications · Virtual Instruments

projects.title: Pymetrics, Inc. - Talent Management
projects.description:
• Consulted for the series B AI-based HR tech startup Pymetrics
• Examined product and marketing opportunities for the talent management solution
• A project between Stern MBA, Union Square Ventures, and Pymetrics as part of NYU Stern MBA course, Tech and the City

projects.title: Virtual Insight, Ltd. - World of Piano
projects.description:
• Developed the server-side of World of Piano, an AR/VR application for music learning
• Used C/C++, Lua, and Pd for handling the communication between the score follower and the client-side using Open Sound Control
• Updated and maintained software
